Priya (CS): Heads up — Kairos (R&D) just asked about onboarding 3 new squads for the "Content Assist" beta. They estimate ~450k tokens/day across squads starting next month. They want near-realtime responses. Is this a ticket for Dedicated pilot or can we support in hosted with config? Also renewal is coming up in 3 months; flagging risk if latency spikes. cc @Ava
Jordan (SE): Quick q — are these mostly short request/response (few hundred tokens) or long-context docs? that'll change batching/latency tradeoffs.
Ava (Solutions Eng): From initial convo it's mostly short prompts, high QPS, low per-request tokens. Realtime-critical. I'd recommend either a small Dedicated pod or increasing burst capacity + tighter SLOs. Also need EU region pinning.
Leo (Platform Eng): Rough estimate: 450k tokens/day = ~5.2 tokens/s avg but with spikes that could be x10. If they hit concurrent spikes we'll see 20-25% load on their current pool. Can we get a spike window? I can run a sim to measure 99p latency. Also can we verify model size they're using?
Ruth (Customer Success): Renewal watch: they mentioned they'll reconsider if responsiveness degrades. Let's capture feedback now: onboarding docs clarity, integration examples, and region guarantees. Need an enablement session for their platform engineers.
Sam (Kairos): We can stagger squads over 4 weeks. Pilot target start May 5 in EU. Model is open-llama-13B right now, may quantize later. Priority is latency not cost.
Ava (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a 1-hr enablement + quickstart repo, and a short SLA note for EU region. I'll also draft a pilot quote for Dedicated capacity (estimate attached in doc).
Jordan (SE): For immediate mitigation: reduce context window, enable prefix caching, and use batching of small requests. If Dedicated, suggest g5-like CPUs + int8 quantization. Also consider request-level caching for repetitive prompts.
Leo (Platform Eng): Action plan: 1) run simulated traffic for EU region by 2026-04-05, 2) provide pilot cost & pod sizing, 3) schedule enablement by week of 2026-04-10, 4) set up SLO monitoring dashboard. I'll own sim, @Ava please own pilot quote + enablement. Priya, can you confirm pilot start date with customer?
Priya (CS): Yep — I'll confirm staggered dates with Sam today and update the doc. Also logging feedback: docs clarity + EU latency guarantee are the two biggest ask items. If we can't hit 99p < 200ms they'll push renewal negotiation. 
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: scheduled canary of EU pod scaling config at 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC.
Ava (Solutions Eng): Got it :thumbsup: I'll add quick curl example to quickstart:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-13b","input":"summarize...","max_tokens":80}'
```
Priya (CS): Final note — risks captured in the account health doc, renewal flagged medium. Next sync Fri 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. Thanks everyone.
